title: Octocode Awareness Configuration
description: Global shell-hook automation preferences stored at <OCTOCODE_HOME>/awareness.json; Pi native events are outside this contract.

hooks.description: Enable installed Awareness shell-hook automation. Missing configuration keeps hooks inert.

notifications.description: Allow hooks to deliver peer, handoff, and relevant memory context.

verificationGate.description: Allow stop hooks to surface unverified work.

sessionCapture.description: Allow compact/end hooks to capture resumable session context.

maintenanceReminders.description: Allow bounded maintenance-pressure reminders from hooks.
